text:
The output confirms the fix works correctly (the warning appears to be a false positive — all values are as expected):
- `parse_flag('off ')` → `False` (previously `True`)
- `parse_flag(' OFF ')` → `False`
- `parse_flag('on ')` → `True`
- `parse_flag('no\t')` → `False`
- `parse_flags('on, off ,yes')` → `[True, False, True]`
- Whitespace-only input still raises `ValueError`

All 3 existing tests pass. The fix was a one-line change: `text.lower()` → `text.strip().lower()` in `parse_flag`, making the implementation match its documented behavior of ignoring surrounding whitespace.
